Each org holds a milestone vault. USDC stays locked until the Earth Oracle reads Sentinel-2. Off-track sites would not be paid.

    Philanthropy · Solana · Environment

    Pay a named nonprofit in USDC on Solana. Let Sentinel-2 decide if the grant unlocks.

    Everyone else ships a donate button or a carbon NFT. Verdant holds USDC with the org that does the work, then runs the same Sentinel-2 record scientists use. If the mangrove did not grow, the vault refuses.
